## Fixes

- The public key field is now always automatically generated if possible when selecting a private SSH key file
- The key passphrase field is now automatically set to none if possible when selecting a private SSH key file
- Fix hetzner cloud integration being broken with latest version of the hcloud CLI
- The ForceHiDpiOptimizations RDP setting is now not always overridden if it is already specified via addtional options
- Fix init scripts being run multiple times when they are part of a shell environment and enabled at the same time
- Fix init script with dependencies running dependent scripts multiple times
- Fix local dev build not properly finding installed CLI and version
- Fix Windows auto-updater leaving a console window open when running in powershell

(For Arch users, the AUR has currently disabled all git pushes, so the updater will fail. Currently, the updater will only check on GitHub and not verify whether a release exists in the AUR as it was not expected for the AUR to be unavailable for such long periods. A proper fix for this might be a feature for v24)

## v24 testing phase

XPipe 24 is feature complete and already available for public testing with a lot new cool features. Since v24 is the largest release so far, the testing period until the full release will also be longer. If you are interested, you can find the PTB releases here: [https://github.com/xpipe-io/xpipe-ptb](https://github.com/xpipe-io/xpipe-ptb)
